title: Machine learning-driven discovery of high-performance MEMS disk resonator gyroscope structural topologies
summary: A D3QN policy searches resonator topologies using CNN surrogate rewards, with finite-element analysis used for evaluation. The source reports many simulated candidate topologies and comparison with a random policy; no physical prototype validation is reported.
